headline: European Natural Gas Surges to 2022 Highs on Middle East Strain
summary: European natural gas futures surged to fresh 2022 highs as ongoing Middle East conflict strains global energy markets.
why: Europe remains sensitive to geopolitical risks impacting global liquefied natural gas availability and fuel supply chains.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Spiking wholesale natural gas prices increase operational costs for European utilities and energy retailers.

why_moved: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East escalates supply disruption fears, driving up wholesale natural gas spot prices.
